Sectoare de activitate: Fabricația de autovehicule
Location Craiova, Romania
 Pacesetting. Passionate. Together. HELLA, one of the leading automotive suppliers worldwide, has shaped the industry with innovative lighting systems and vehicle electronics. In addition, the company is one of the most important partners of the aftermarket and independent workshops. What motivates us: Shaping the mobility of tomorrow and fostering the central market trends such as autonomous driving, efficiency and electrification, connectivity and digitization as well as individualization. Every day, 36,000 employees worldwide are committed to this with passion, know-how and innovative strength.
 YOUR TASKS
 Body Electronics Design and Development department gives you the opportunity to develop and apply your technical knowledge and creative thinking in various activities like: defining project architecture based on AUTOSAR standard, design and implement specific applications using C programming language or Model Based Design tools, design hardware layout and define hardware architecture. Also, you can grow within system engineering team and develop system architectures and system requirements. If your interest is in project management, you can learn how to organize and plan activities in our projects.
A team of over 170 embedded engineers is ready to support you with guidance and training on the job in complete project software development activities from quotation up to end of production.
 Performing development tasks based on existing hardware specifications and architectures 
 Creating/updating and validating (worst case calculation & simulation) circuit diagrams 
 Keeping track of your activities and deadlines 
 Writing test specifications and performing hardware electrical test on development samples 
 In close contact with the design team, experts and project management 
 Integrated and supported by a personal experienced mentor 
 Your Qualifications
Hardware engineering experience or proficient electronics profile university graduate
 Knowledge of embedded hardware design and analogical and digital circuit development 
 Working experience with Spice-based simulation programs and worst case circuit calculations tools (e.g. MathCAD) 
 Knowledge about automotive communication protocols (e.g. CAN/LIN) 
 Good knowledge of English 
 OUR OFFER
 Open feedback culture with plenty of room for innovative ideas and design options which will motivate you to take responsibility and organize yourself. 
 Colleagues who are true to their job and experts in their field are at your side to support and advise. 
 You will be integrated into your new tasks and will receive all the necessary support and individual training. We train you individually according to your skills and knowledge in order to promote your personal and professional development. 
 You will be assigned an experienced mentor to guide your first steps. 
 Look forward to flexible and mobile work. You'll get extra vacation days according to your tenure. 
 We convince with a modern workplace in a top location. 
 Guidance in defining your career path in the field. 
 We offer continuous improvement opportunities according to your desired career path. 
 Each employee is evaluated transparently according to company unified criteria. 
 Take the opportunity to reveal your potential within a global, family-run company that offers you the best possible conditions for progressing in your career.
Please send us your application through our careers portal, citing reference number req18418.
